_comment: Pinned upstream benchmark suites for the stress category. The suites are NOT committed here: tools/stress/fetch.sh checks them out at these shas into $STRESS_SUITES (default ~/zg-measure/stress-suites). A run serves them from 127.0.0.1 only.

speedometer.licence: BSD 2-Clause (LICENSE in the repo); workloads carry their own licences under resources/
speedometer.build: none: every workload's dist/ is committed upstream

motionmark.runner: MotionMark/index.html (started by benchmarkController.startBenchmark()); MotionMark/developer.html?suite-name=...&test-name=... for one subtest

jetstream.licence: no top-level licence file at this sha; each workload directory carries its own (BSD, MIT, Apache-2.0, LGPL among them). Not redistributed by this repository.
jetstream.runner: index.html?report=true (starts itself 4 s after load, POSTs its results JSON to /report on the serving origin)
